title: The Hotel by the Lake
subtitle: 考点：旅行 / We go hiking on the trip.

dialogue.t: Dad, is our hotel close to the forest?
Yes. It is only ten minutes' walk.
Great! Can we go hiking tomorrow?
Yes. But we must start early. The fog is heavy in the morning.
Bring water, some bread and a map.
I know. I will also bring my camera.

vocab: hotel 酒店 · close 近的 · forest 森林 · fog 雾 · bring 带来 · know 知道 · go hiking 去徒步
